tools.name: x402_precheck
tools.description: Check an x402 payment challenge BEFORE your agent pays (0.002 USDC per check via x402; free trial 1024 checks/IP/UTC day). Give an endpoint URL (fetched unpaid, never paid) or paste a 402 challenge. Validates x402 version, scheme, network (CAIP-2, testnet flag), canonical USDC asset, amount sanity,
